item.title: November 2026 Status Update
item.description: Welcome Back? Wow —yes, hello there, everyone. I am still alive and very much kicking – and screaming? – here on our favorite starship starbeam.one. You could say we had some issues in 2024 – both financial and technical – that sidelined blog activity, and it never got settled until now. Truth be told, blogging is a bit… antiquated? I have been doing daily updates on X for over two years now, starting in September of 2024.
